flags.why: “Kì đến ngày gặp lại” is not a natural Vietnamese farewell; the attested construction expresses persistence toward a result, as in [“làm cho kì được”](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/k%C3%AC).
flags.fix: Tôi sẽ làm cho kì được. = I will keep trying until I succeed.

flags.why: The example defines the word instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Thuế từ vùng kì được nộp về kinh đô. = Taxes from the territory around the capital were remitted to the capital.

flags.why: “Vị giác” means the sense of taste, whereas the translation incorrectly says appetite.
flags.fix: The aroma of the dish stimulates the sense of taste.

flags.why: “Lồng” means a cage without requiring it to be round.
